description: Predicts weekly dry bulk freight rates (USD/MT) for 12 trade corridors into India's East Coast ports (Paradip, Vizag, Gangavaram, Dhamra, Haldia, Gopalpur) across 7 vessel classes (Handysize–Newcastlemax). Trained on BDI-calibrated voyage economics from real market signals (2015-2026).

training_data.source: Baltic Dry Index (Yahoo Finance/Stooq) + World Bank Commodity Pink Sheet + Yahoo Finance commodity/FX data

deep_bilstm_attention.architecture: Linear Embed → BiLSTM (hidden=128) → Multi-Head Attention (4h) → LayerNorm → MLP → Point + Quantile Heads

evaluation_methodology: Temporal walk-forward split — 85% train, 15% held-out test. No data leakage.
explainability: TreeSHAP (shap.TreeExplainer) on XGBoost for per-feature attribution per prediction

artifacts.freight_xgb_model.joblib: Serialized tree ensemble + StandardScaler + SHAP explainer
artifacts.freight_deep_lstm.pt: PyTorch state dict + feature scaler + training history
artifacts.metrics.json: Benchmark evaluation on held-out test set
artifacts.feature_schema.json: Input feature names, sources, and descriptions
